entries.title: Job 16:1
segments: Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 16:2
segments: I have heard many such things: Miserable comforters are ye all.

entries.title: Job 16:3
segments: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provoketh thee that thou answerest?

entries.title: Job 16:4
segments: I also could speak as ye do; If your soul were in my soul's stead, I could join words together against you, And shake my head at you.

entries.title: Job 16:5
segments: [But] I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the solace of my lips would assuage [your grief].

entries.title: Job 16:6
segments: Though I speak, my grief is not assuaged; And though I forbear, what am I eased?

entries.title: Job 16:7
segments: But now he hath made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.

entries.title: Job 16:8
segments: And thou hast laid fast hold on me, [which] is a witness [against me]: And my leanness riseth up against me, It testifieth to my face.

entries.title: Job 16:9
segments: He hath torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me; He hath gnashed upon me with his teeth: Mine adversary sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

entries.title: Job 16:10
segments: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; They have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully: They gather themselves together against me.

entries.title: Job 16:11
segments: God delivereth me to the ungodly, And casteth me into the hands of the wicked.

entries.title: Job 16:12
segments: I was at ease, and he brake me asunder; Yea, he hath taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces: He hath also set me up for his mark.

entries.title: Job 16:13
segments: His archers compass me round about; He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.

entries.title: Job 16:14
segments: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; He runneth upon me like a giant.

entries.title: Job 16:15
segments: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And have laid my horn in the dust.

entries.title: Job 16:16
segments: My face is red with weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 16:17
segments: Although there is no violence in my hands, And my prayer is pure.

entries.title: Job 16:18
segments: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no [resting] -place.

entries.title: Job 16:19
segments: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And he that voucheth for me is on high.

entries.title: Job 16:20
segments: My friends scoff at me: [But] mine eye poureth out tears unto God,

entries.title: Job 16:21
segments: That he would maintain the right of a man with God, And of a son of man with his neighbor!

entries.title: Job 16:22
segments: For when a few years are come, I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
